message.content: The company faces supply chain constraints acting as a governor on near-term revenue conversion, which would be confirmed if management's statement regarding the supply environment being less flexible than a year ago proves accurate [D3]. The risk of one-time tariff impacts artificially inflating FY26 profitability that will not repeat in future periods could negatively affect margins, a scenario supported by the executive vice president and chief financial officer's caution about these non-recurring effects [D3]. A shift in the wireline business mix from a historical 80-20 R&D-to-manufacturing split to approximately 2-3 manufacturing as AI data center build-outs scale represents an operational risk that would be confirmed by the reported change in revenue composition [D4]. The company's ability to sustain $2 billion quarterly order levels is at risk if demand durability proves insufficient, a concern highlighted by analyst questions on whether demand is sustainable and supply constraints are limiting guidance [D3]. The valuation leaves little room for error given the substantial gap between current trading levels and price targets, which would be confirmed if the stock fails to meet the high expectations set by analysts following the earnings beat [D2].
